title: bug: since CQ-M07s (edc3e937), daemon-autostart-argv.test.mjs fails on Windows CI (PS 5.1 and 7), because it requires exactly one Start-Process passing --project in moe-agent.ps1 and the check-dispatch launch is a second one
description:
CI run 41894749395 (PR #230, d05e6e0b), job Build (windows-latest), failed at step "Test PowerShell daemon autostart arguments" (`node --test scripts/tests/daemon-autostart-argv.test.mjs`, Windows only). Both engines fail at daemon-autostart-argv.test.mjs:125 with "the driver failed: expected exactly one Start-Process passing --project in moe-agent.ps1, found 2" (driver.ps1:7).

Cause: edc3e937 (task-74fe4c99, CQ-M07s) added `$script:CheckDispatchProcess = Start-Process -FilePath $Node -ArgumentList (ConvertTo-MoeArgumentLine @($script:CheckDispatchCli, '--project', ...))`. The test locates the daemon-autostart Start-Process with "the only Start-Process passing --project", and that locator is now ambiguous. The launcher code is correct. The test's locator is too loose. Counts of matching lines: 1 at 95155388, 2 at edc3e937 and later.

Fix the locator so it selects the daemon-autostart call specifically, for example by its daemon entry / `start` argument or its enclosing function, and keep every assertion the test makes about that call. Main carries this red test since the human merged PR #230 red (2026-11-04: "we will fix ci later"). LOW so it never preempts a task row; idle workers only.
definitionOfDone: daemon-autostart-argv.test.mjs locates exactly the daemon-autostart Start-Process, unaffected by the check-dispatch Start-Process or any future Start-Process passing --project. Its assertions on that call (literal-name paths passed as whole arguments) are unchanged.

The test passes on Windows PowerShell 5.1 and PowerShell 7 on this host, with the run output in the completion summary. It still fails against a mutant that breaks the autostart call's argument quoting.
The gate is a single run of that test file through a Windows node (it only runs on Windows), well under the 20-min GLOBAL gate budget.
reopenReason: Duplicate of task-e5211efd (filed by architect-67c762f6 one minute earlier, 19:31:56Z, for the same daemon-autostart-argv.test.mjs failure). This row's DoD points were carried onto e5211efd as a planning comment.
